name: Get Email Content Sections
summary: Lists the email's editable content sections (subject, header, body blocks, …).
whenToUse: When you want to see the sections an email is built from (each has an htmlId).

query.name: status
query.label: Version
query.hint: Return the sections from the approved or draft version.

response.description: The email's editable sections: htmlId, type, content, …

notes: The htmlId of each section is what the section-update endpoints need.
